title: Wilted Wrap Noodle Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy Japanese-inspired stir fry made with wilted wrap noodles, herbal seasonings and warm wok-fried ingredients.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the minced ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the wilted spinach and stir-fry until it's well combined with the mushrooms and ginger.
Add the wrap noodles and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until they're well coated with the sauce.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, honey, and green chili flakes.
Pour the sauce over the noodles and stir-fry for another minute.
Transfer the noodles to a serving platter and garnish with sliced green onions, if desired.
